howItWorks.title: Three steps to a perfect event
howItWorks.subtitle: From first idea to final toast, Rattibha keeps every detail coordinated.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Share your event type, date, city and budget in under two minutes.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We surface verified planners that fit your vision — review their work and message directly.

about.title: Built for the Kingdom's celebrations
about.subtitle: Rattibha started with a simple idea: finding a trustworthy event planner shouldn't take weeks of messaging and guesswork. We built a marketplace where every planner is verified, every quote is transparent, and every deposit is protected until the day goes exactly as planned.

quotes.text: Rattibha matched us with a planner who understood our vision instantly. Our wedding was flawless.
Booked our entire annual celebration in a week. Professional, transparent, stress-free.
The birthday party exceeded every expectation. Booking and paying was effortless.

cta.title: Grow your planning practice with Rattibha
cta.subtitle: Reach clients who are ready to invest in a perfectly coordinated celebration. Rattibha handles bookings, payments and reviews so you can focus on the craft.

trust.title: Peace of mind, every step
trust.subtitle: From first quote to final toast — your experience is protected.
trust.verifiedDesc: Every coordinator passes a background, portfolio and reference check before joining Rattibha.
trust.quotesDesc: You receive itemised, written quotes — no hidden fees, no surprises on the day.
trust.depositDesc: Your deposit is held securely and only released to your coordinator after the event is delivered.
trust.reviewsDesc: Reviews come only from verified bookings — so you always know what past clients truly experienced.
